implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosure is a gating event: once >25% or a control threshold is breached, a formal open offer to remaining shareholders becomes mandatory within 60 days unless specific exemptions apply-track whether this progresses to a full takeover notice (Schedule 2-A filing).

framework.note: Mandatory disclosure requirement when acquirer crosses 5% or 25% threshold; must be filed within 2 trading days of acquisition.
Definitions of 'acquisition', 'control', and 'voting rights'; determines whether open offer is mandatory.
Open offer notice and conditions; unless exemption is granted under Regulation 10 or 11, acquirer must make offer to all public shareholders at discovered price.
Approval by stock exchange for substantial acquisition and takeover notice filing; exchange conducts merit review.
Exemption grounds: acquisition by 'persons not acting in concert', purchase on stock exchange <5% per month, or acquirer already holding >55%.
Financing disclosures: source of funds, debt details, and arrangement terms must be disclosed in open offer document.
Continuous disclosure obligations and insider trading restrictions during takeover period; lookout notices may apply.
